rows.grounds: past passive participle indicating what has been told
noun denoting a place of union or assembly
noun denoting a location or seat
past passive participle indicating what has been received aurally
second-person pronoun indicating the recipient or agent of hearing
past passive participle indicating what is desired or undertaken
adjective qualifying the declared and sought matters

items.question: What auspicious meeting place and desired matters have been declared and heard?
premises: The meeting place and abode have been declared.
These matters have been heard by the addressee.
The sought outcome is described as auspicious.
items.inference: The auspicious meeting place and the desired matters have now been fully communicated and received.
uncertainties: The precise referent of ceṣṭitaṃ as desired object or undertaken activity is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The meeting place and abode have been declared; you have heard what was sought, and it is auspicious.
